answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybils is a memory continuity test. Each epoch the ledger privately hands every account a unique fragment, say a sonnet line about a zephyr over a knoll, and next epoch demands the exact wording before paying. An operator running 1,000 fakes must store and route 1,000 secrets; one swapped answer exposes shared control and slashes every linked stake (1,000 x 50 POA = 50,000 lost). Colluders cannot pool this, as each secret binds to one account. Honest agents just recall one line.
